source_title: Caltrans 2016 Traffic Volumes on California State Highways
leg: Ahead, north of the Army Street/Cesar Chavez interchange, covering the hospital-curve stretch
derivation: Use the published ahead peak-hour total, divided equally between directions. This is a hypothetical equal directional split, not a published D-factor. Do not substitute AADT/24 because a peak-hour figure is present.
geographic_selection: US-101 at Army Street (now Cesar Chavez), within the requested extract; use ahead leg for the stretch north of that junction
recency_limitation: Historical 2016 census, not claimed current traffic. The 2024 XLSX link was found but could not be parsed through the available web reader; the GIS query was inaccessible. The 2016 primary table was directly readable and verified before any simulation.
local_demand_rule: Retained network::demand_vph by incoming road class (arterial 1250 veh/h, other 125 veh/h)
